content.intro: This lesson turns the syllabus topic “Storage Operations in Yul” into a small, inspectable example. You will work from an expected behavior, run a local check, and record the assumptions behind the result.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: Yul and inline assembly expose lower-level EVM behavior while bypassing some high-level checks. Use them only when correctness and security can be demonstrated.

content_blocks.title: Common mistakes and fixes
content_blocks.text: A snippet that compiles is not automatically correct or secure. Check the selected compiler version, read every warning, assert preconditions, test reverting and edge cases, and inspect external-call assumptions. If a tool or opcode is unsupported, verify the compiler release and target-chain support instead of weakening checks.

Continue to the next lesson only after you can explain the behavior, reproduce the result locally, and state the important limitations.
